package.name: nidar_config
package.description: Single source of truth for the NIDAR AirMouse stack. Owns mission_config.yaml (arena, vehicle, planner and mission numbers), the arena grid, the flight envelope guard limits, and apply_mission_config.py, which renders the derived files that cannot read the ROS parameter server (FAST-LIO YAML, FUEL launch literals, vehicle SDF, Gazebo world). Depends on nothing else in this repo.
